# Seething Silhouette (Rehan)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, resource, uptime, conditional

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Rage is NOT simulated — `rage_amount` (0-100, default 100) and `berserk_active` (bool, default True) are plain user-set conditions; every Rage generation/drain clause is informational only. 'Bonuses use 2x Max Rage while Berserk is active' is modeled as effective_rage = rage_amount x (2 if berserk_active else 1), applied only to the Attack-Speed-per-Rage line and Artificial Moon's Double Damage chance. FULL COVERAGE of the node tree (base trait, Artificial Moon, all 6 advanced picks) including Seething Spirit: modeled as a SECOND, independent calculate_offense() call on a clone of the player's own materialized main-skill stats (Ritual of Offering's permanent Spirit; Fury's Onslaught's use-triggered Spirit), scaled by the user-set `seething_spirit_uptime` condition (0-100%, default 100 — a tunable knob, not a computed real-time ramp) rather than being simulated in real time. Fury's Onslaught's own '+% additional damage dealt BY THE PLAYER' line is explicitly excluded from Spirit's copy (tooltip-scoped to the player only) via `spirit_grant()`'s `player_only_dmg_to_exclude`. Ritual of Offering's player-Disarm zeroes the player's own DPS (`StatResult.offense`/`slot_offense`) unless Rage Infusion is also selected (its 5s un-Disarm ramp treated as immediate for a steady-state calc). Surfaced in the UI as its own DPS row (BuildSidebar) and a Player/Seething Spirit toggle (PlayerStatsScreen). NOT modeled (informational only, defensive/EHP scope): Ritual of Offering's self-damage-over-time tick, Split Form's Life-Regain utility line. See backend/engine/hero_traits/seething_silhouette.py's status_lines for the exact per-line breakdown. FIXED (bug-279, 2026-09-10): Spirit's independent calculate_offense() call previously hardcoded is_main_skill=False and passed no add_mod_tags, so a +N Main Skill Level source (gear/support/talent) or a tag-scoped +<Tag> Skill Level bonus reached via a granted tag raised the player's effective level and damage but left Spirit's frozen at the un-boosted level — base skill level itself always scaled both correctly, in lockstep, only the bonus-stat path was dropped. Spirit now passes is_main_skill=True and the main slot's granted tags (_granted_tags_by_slot), matching that it casts the player's own main skill.
